transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’ve been having these times after my evening class where I stop for food and just keep eating. I’ll get a whole fast-food meal, then candy from a vending machine, and when I get home I’ll have more snacks. It feels like I’m trying to make up for not eating enough during the day.
During those times when you keep eating, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you’re eating?
Yeah. Once I start on the snacks, I keep telling myself to close the bag and just go to bed, but I don’t. My hands just keep reaching for more. By the end I feel embarrassed and sick of myself.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
A few times, yes. After those late-night eating spells, I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up because I was scared all that food would show on me.
Is your weight much lower than what other people or your doctor consider healthy for your height?
I’m not really sure what would count as too low for my height. I haven’t noticed people saying I look underweight.
During those eating episodes, do you feel like you lose control over your eating?
Yeah, I do. I’ll tell myself to stop and close the bag, but I just keep reaching for more anyway. It feels like I can’t make myself quit until afterward, when I feel embarrassed and sick about it.
What is your current height and weight?
I’m not sure of my exact height and weight right now. I haven’t checked recently.
Are you very afraid of gaining weight?
Yeah. Even if the scale is up just a pound the next morning, I get this knot in my stomach. I start worrying people in class will look at me like I’m some sloppy old guy who’s let himself go.
Do you deliberately eat very little during the day to try to keep from gaining weight?
I’m not really sure what counts as deliberately eating very little. I do worry about my weight a lot, but I haven’t really kept track of how much I eat during the day.
Has a doctor or anyone else ever told you that your weight was too low for your height?
No, nobody’s told me that. I don’t think my weight’s ever been considered too low.
About how often do you make yourself vomit after these eating episodes?
For the past three months or so, it’s usually been at least once a week—after class, at night. I overeat and then make myself throw up.
When this happens, do you eat an unusually large amount of food for the situation?

Yes. After my evening class, I’ll sometimes get a whole fast-food meal, candy from the vending machine, and then keep eating snacks once I get home. It feels like I’m making up for not eating enough all day.
Besides making yourself vomit, do you ever use laxatives, diuretics, fasting, or excessive exercise after eating to try to prevent weight gain?
I’m not really sure what counts as excessive exercise. I do know I make myself throw up afterward.
